flagged.reason: The video teaches the old definition assigning equipment setup to the technician rather than the engineer, which directly contradicts the NCFE specification criteria and would cost students marks.

mark_affecting.quote: A technician is the person responsible for setting up, operating and maintaining the equipment... technician means setup and maintenance, engineer means recording and mixing.

mark_affecting.quote: Formats in order: vinyl, cassette, CD, minidisc, MP3, music video, streaming. / You really need to memorize this exact list of consumer formats in approximate chronological order.
